purpose: Run the B / frozen intervention on the only non-Moirai cells with a demonstrated capability, and ask whether the paper's findings hold off Moirai.

screen.note: Both Traffic held-out gates (+0.231, +0.207) are within 0.04 of the 0.20 threshold and are reported as marginal passes.

data.source: laiguokun/multivariate-time-series-data traffic.txt.gz, last series as OT

chronos.B: full fine-tune of the T5 encoder + MSE head
chronos.D: encoder AND shared token embedding frozen, only the MSE head trains; this is a strict freeze by construction (CKA 1, drift 0), so on Chronos D is also the strict-freeze arm and no separate H is run

timesfm.D: transformer stack frozen, input tokenizer and output heads trainable
timesfm.H: strict freeze: stack AND tokenizer frozen, only the output heads train

seeds.note: each backbone's existing seed list, extended to 5

environment.note: Every run in this arm is fresh on this device. Chronos's sampled zero-shot differs across devices (ETTh1 seed 42: 1.3245 on A10G against 1.3349 on record), so these cells are never pooled with the matrix's existing records; they are reported as their own arm.

statistics.outcome_window: held-out test windows (200, seed 0), scored once after training
statistics.chronos_contrast: d_enc = (test_mse_B - test_mse_D) / zs_test * 100 per seed, paired on seed, with D's head chosen by the matrix rule (closed-form ridge if its validation loss is within 5% of the AdamW head's, else AdamW). Chronos forgetting against zero-shot is NOT read: zero-shot runs through the generative decoder and B/D through the MSE head, the confound the matrix already declares.
statistics.timesfm_contrast: d_enc = forgetting_pct_test(B) - forgetting_pct_test(H) per seed (primary), and the same with D (secondary)
statistics.interval: two-sided 95% t-interval on the 5 paired differences; mean +- SEM reported
statistics.call: 'freezing better' if the interval lies above 0, 'adapting better' if below, 'inconclusive' otherwise
statistics.degradation_definition: TimesFM only (native head on both sides): gate >= 0.20 on the selection split AND forgetting_B > 0 in every seed AND forgetting_frozen < 0 in every seed, frozen = H (primary) or D
statistics.cka: final_cka of each B run, encoder output against the pre-trained encoder on the selection windows, as each trainer already records it

outcomes_fixed_in_advance: O1: TimesFM/Traffic meets the degradation definition -> the paper has its first harm case. Its B CKA is reported against Chronos/Traffic's and against the Moirai cells, and the abstract's 'no cell meets the definition' is narrowed to the cells it covers.

O2: some cell's call is 'freezing better' without meeting the definition -> reported as a non-Moirai cell where the frozen arm wins, beside its CKA; the drift claim is tested on whether the lower-CKA cell is the one where freezing wins, as an observation on two cells, not an inference.

O3: both calls are 'adapting better' or 'inconclusive' -> the Moirai finding that adaptation is not harmful where a capability exists extends to two further backbones on one dataset; reported with the marginal-gate caveat.
also_reported: per-seed CKA, l2 drift, best epoch and selection-window forgetting for every run
the strict-freeze check: Chronos D and TimesFM H must show CKA 1.000; a run that does not is reported and excluded from the H contrast with the reason
whether Traffic appears in each backbone's published pre-training corpus
what_this_cannot_show: Two cells on one dataset cannot estimate a correlation between CKA and the intervention; this arm tests whether the paper's per-cell findings hold on two more backbones where a capability exists.
